_comment: Gold-standard extraction cases, English. ENTIRELY SYNTHETIC.
Written in the register of Commonwealth-trained clinicians, because that is
who an English deployment of this app serves: Kenya, Nigeria, Ghana, Uganda,
Tanzania. od/bd/tds/qds for frequency and 5/7 for duration are standard on
handwritten charts across anglophone Africa, and an English pack that cannot
read `tds` is close to useless in the places it would actually be deployed.
The cmHg cases are the mirror image of the French ones: '12 over 8' in English
is a value to question rather than silently multiply by ten.

cases.notes: Baseline, with Commonwealth shorthand for both frequency and duration.
cases.text: Presenting complaint fever for three days. Temperature thirty-eight point five, pulse ninety-two, blood pressure 120 over 80. Diagnosis uncomplicated malaria. Paracetamol 500 mg tds for 5/7.

cases.notes: The key divergence from the French pack. '12 over 8' is implausible in English and must be REJECTED, not read as 120/80.
od / bd / tds / qds across four drugs, each with its own duration.
cases.text: Amoxicillin 500 mg tds for 7/7, metronidazole 400 mg bd for 5/7, folic acid 5 mg od for 30/7.

cases.notes: Artemether lumefantrine is one drug. Also the standard 3-day ACT course.
cases.text: Diagnosis malaria. Artemether lumefantrine bd for three days.

cases.notes: Dropped decimal. 385 is not a temperature.
cases.text: Temperature three hundred and eighty five.

cases.notes: IMCI fast-breathing case: respiratory rate is the trigger and must not be read as pulse.
cases.text: Presenting complaint cough for four days. Temperature thirty-nine point two, respiratory rate fifty, pulse one hundred and forty, oxygen saturation ninety-one percent. Diagnosis severe pneumonia.
Weight sixty-eight point five kilograms, height one hundred and seventy two centimetres.

cases.notes: Adult follow-up. Values already in mmHg.
cases.text: Presenting complaint headache. Blood pressure 165 over 100, pulse 78. Diagnosis hypertension. Amlodipine 5 mg od for 30/7.

cases.notes: Narrative only. Anything extracted is invented.
cases.text: Presenting complaint back pain. Diagnosis mechanical low back pain.

cases.notes: End-to-end, the shape a real dictation takes.
cases.text: Presenting complaint fever and vomiting for two days. Temperature thirty-eight point eight, pulse one hundred and four, blood pressure 105 over 65, respiratory rate 22. Diagnosis uncomplicated malaria. Artemether lumefantrine bd for 3/7 and paracetamol 1 g tds for 3/7.
